name: hackban
title: Hackban
description: See what's due, search your boards, and capture cards in Hackban, Hack Club's Trello, across every server you use.
author: leowilkin

commands.name: my-cards
commands.title: My Cards
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Cards you're a member of, grouped by when they're due.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Hackban
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Search board names and card titles and descriptions.

commands.name: boards
commands.title: Browse Boards
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Your workspaces and boards, with each board's lists and cards.

commands.name: create-card
commands.title: Create Card
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Add a card to any list on your boards.

commands.name: notifications
commands.title: Notifications
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Cards you were added to and comments on cards you watch.

commands.name: accounts
commands.title: Manage Accounts
commands.subtitle: Hackban
commands.description: Sign in to more Hackban servers, and rename, recolor, reorder, hide or sign out of them.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
